measurement: Projected current-context tokens in offline replay. Medians include no-plan cases. Literal-string retention is not task accuracy.
privacy: Aggregate statistics only. Private transcripts, session identifiers, paths, per-session hashes, manifests and per-session results are not published.
limitations: One person and one Mac; sessions may share prompts, projects or unobserved ancestry.
No provider continuation, billing, semantic judge or remote model was evaluated.
The measured extractor had a nominal 64-probe cap but could emit 65–67 probes; the reported denominators are actual counts.
Structural deltas compare severity/code counts, not finding identity or proof of safe provider resume.
Resampling intervals describe the selected stratum only; they are not population confidence intervals.
Cohort strata overlap: do not add native-compacted, no-native-compaction and no-observed-parent rows together.
